summary: A doctor led aesthetics clinic in Harborne appears to lose patients to a free builder address, a 2016 footer and an offer that ended in 2016.

findings.problem: The page appears to run on a free Wix address with a Wix banner, even though it lists boysonhealthcare.co.uk as your site.
findings.cost: Patients pay for injectables on trust, and a builder advert at the top makes a doctor led clinic look less established.
findings.fix: Your own domain with no banner.

findings.problem: The footer appears to say 2016 by Boyson Healthcare Ltd.
findings.cost: A 2016 date makes visitors wonder if the clinic is still open and prices are current.
findings.fix: A current site with a live date.

findings.problem: The page appears to still show 10 pounds off ANY treatment, ends 31/03/16.
findings.cost: An offer that ended years ago tells patients nobody is looking after the page, and they book elsewhere.
findings.fix: An offers block you update yourself.

findings.problem: Opening hours appear to say please enquire, and the contact is a doctor.com email and one mobile with no WhatsApp.
findings.cost: A patient who cannot see hours or message quickly tries the next clinic.
findings.fix: Clear hours and a one tap WhatsApp button.
